description: This file contains serialization, surrogate, and copying logic for the SortedSet<T> collection in Orleans serialization framework. It includes a serializer class (SortedSetCodec), a surrogate type (SortedSetSurrogate), and a copier class (SortedSetCopier) to handle deep copying of SortedSet instances.

classes.name: SortedSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for SortedSet<T> that converts instances to and from a surrogate form.

classes.name: SortedSetSurrogate<T>
classes.description: A surrogate struct used for serializing SortedSet<T>, containing its elements and comparer.

classes.name: SortedSetCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for SortedSet<T> that creates deep copies of the set's elements.

methods.name: SortedSetCodec<T>.ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into a SortedSet<T> instance.

methods.name: SortedSetCodec<T>.ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a SortedSet<T> into its surrogate representation for serialization.

methods.name: SortedSetCopier<T>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a SortedSet<T>.

methods.name: SortedSetCopier<T>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Copies elements from the input SortedSet<T> to the output SortedSet<T>.
